_comment: Hand-curated blocker registry. 'files_blocked' lists asm files whose decomp failed on this blocker; gating estimates (which pending files this blocker likely also affects) are computed by coverage_ledger.py from the symbol graph at generation time. Keep fix_plan current — fixing the blocker that gates the most files is worth more than individual decomps.

blockers.description: MWCC -ipa file: changing a signature in a shared header cascades codegen changes into every already-matched caller in other compilation units. Files sharing many declarations (sound.h family) must be decompiled together or after a coordinated header fix.
blockers.fix_plan: Identify the header-sharing cluster (sound.h / sound_chatot.h consumers), fix all signatures in one change, and re-match affected files in a single commit. Alternatively decompile the cluster as a group.

blockers.description: 120 main.sha1 mismatches caused by IPA cascade from the upstream merge (7ec854e90). 24 headers differ between upstream's overlay_44 matching state and our fork's decomps. MWCC -ipa file cascades codegen changes when ANY declaration in a header changes — even adding new declarations for uncalled functions. Overlay_44 files were matched on upstream with a minimal header; our fork's files were matched with an extended header. Both can't use the same header without one side mismatching. A/B tested: confirmed even adding declarations (without changing existing prototypes) produces different .o files.
blockers.fix_plan: Re-verify each upstream-origin file (overlay_44_0222CDAC, overlay_44_02235340, overlay_44_02232E9C, and other upstream files that include changed headers) with objdiff against the current header state. For files whose codegen changed: adjust C to re-match, or isolate them from the changed headers using local declarations (as done for sound_02004A44.h). The 24 changed headers between commits 8a245deef and 0ee6298b1 are the full scope.

blockers.description: MWCC copy-propagates parameter copies: 'adds r4, r0, #0; cmp r4, #N' at function entry cannot be produced from pure C (MWCC substitutes back to r0). Affected functions need the NONMATCHING inline-asm fallback.
blockers.fix_plan: Use NONMATCHING inline asm for the single affected function (OamManager_Create) and re-land the file with the other 10/11 matched functions in C.

blockers.description: RESOLVED. The stale u16 GF_GetVolumeBySeqNo() was removed from sound_02004A44.h. unk_02004A44.c now uses sound_02004A44_internal.h (split header pattern). overlay_44 files use local declarations with upstream-compatible types (K&R empty-parens for GF_GetVolumeBySeqNo, void params for sub_0200F478). field_bgm.c excluded from the header (has own stale local declarations). Build compiles end-to-end; individual functions verified matching via objdiff.
blockers.fix_plan: No further action needed for this blocker. The remaining 120 SHA1 mismatches are tracked under ipa-merge-cascade.
